notes: Project Architecture Intelligence contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESCRIPTIVE · not prescriptive. Answers 'how is this project actually structured?' · never 'is it good?'. Read-only. Deterministic.

confidence_states.definition: directly supported by repository evidence · e.g. import line in a specific file
large sample corroborates · e.g. 90% of imports match the pattern
small sample suggests · flagged for caution

required_top_level_fields.name: scan_stats
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · { files_scanned, files_excluded, imports_extracted, elapsed_ms, sampling_methodology }

required_top_level_fields.name: cycles
required_top_level_fields.shape: array of { cycle_id, members[], size, confidence } · enumerated · never judged

required_top_level_fields.name: fan_in
required_top_level_fields.shape: array of { node_id, count } · deterministic sort

required_top_level_fields.name: fan_out
required_top_level_fields.shape: array of { node_id, count } · deterministic sort

required_top_level_fields.name: boundaries
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · { test, api, configuration, build, deployment, generated, vendor } · each has files[] + confidence

required_top_level_fields.name: packages
required_top_level_fields.shape: array of detected packages (monorepo workspaces or single_package)

required_top_level_fields.name: cross_package_edges
required_top_level_fields.shape: array · edges that cross detected package boundaries

required_top_level_fields.name: orphans
required_top_level_fields.shape: array of node_ids with zero fan-in AND zero fan-out (excluding entry points)

required_top_level_fields.name: byte_identity_witness
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · { before_hash, after_hash, files_examined, drift_count, drifted[] }

node_fields.name: node_id
node_fields.shape: string · deterministic · sha256_prefix of relative path

node_fields.name: node_type
node_fields.shape: enum · file · package · module · symbol · external_dependency

node_fields.name: package
node_fields.shape: string · package name if part of a package

edge_fields.name: edge_id
edge_fields.shape: string · deterministic · sha256_prefix of source_id + '|' + target_id + '|' + edge_type

edge_fields.name: edge_type
edge_fields.shape: enum · import · require · dynamic_import · reexport · symbol_reference

edge_fields.name: direction
edge_fields.shape: enum · out · in (always 'out' from source to target · included for query symmetry)

edge_fields.name: raw_specifier
edge_fields.shape: string · the actual specifier from source · never normalised silently

boundary_fields.name: boundary_kind
boundary_fields.shape: test | api | configuration | build | deployment | generated | vendor

cycle_fields.name: cycle_id
cycle_fields.shape: string · deterministic hash of sorted member ids

cycle_fields.name: raw_paths
cycle_fields.shape: array of the actual source paths in cycle order (for founder audit)

invariants: no forbidden vocabulary appears in any output field
cycles are enumerated with member node_ids · never labelled as 'bad'
orphans are enumerated · never labelled · orphan doesn't imply defective
fan_in / fan_out are counts · never scored · never percentiled
internal_external classification uses ProjectProfile + heuristic path resolution · unresolved is honest
determinism_witness runs analysis twice and compares · identical=false is a bug
byte_identity_witness verifies no source file changed during scan
reuse: generated/vendor path markers reuse Code Intelligence registry via ProjectProfile scanner's markers
language detection reuses Code Intelligence extension map
test file identification reuses ProjectProfile.test_naming_pattern where available
